title: Unilever Makes 35 Million-Euro Investment in Indian R&D Centers to Develop ‘Next Generation’ Products
summary: The consumer giant has earmarked the funds for existing projects including Liquids Lab of the Future, the Unilever Fragrance House, and AI and digital modeling platforms.

extraction.key_fact: 유니레버가 인도 연구개발 센터에 투자해 차세대 제품을 개발한다.
